description: Detrend and search for the period
content: Normalises PDCSAP_FLUX using only points with quality flag 0, and removes the trend by dividing by a moving median of window_days days. Searches for the period with Box Least Squares, and shows the detrended light curve as a line chart.

outputs.name: detrended
outputs.description: The result of detrending and searching for the period
